name: lsp
description: Resolve a Zig symbol through zls: where it is defined, or everywhere it is referenced. WHEN TO USE: any question of the form "where does this come from" or "what would break if I change this" — zls answers against the real semantic model, so it never confuses a definition with the same word in a comment, a string, or an unrelated scope. WHEN NOT TO USE: for finding text or a code shape, use search_code (rg for text, ast-grep for structure); for reading a file, use read_file. Positions are 0-based, the way LSP counts, and results come back 1-based as path:line:column. Input: {"action": "definition" | "references", "file": "src/agent/loop.zig", "line": 120, "character": 8}.

file.description: Path to the Zig file, relative to the project root.

character.description: 0-based column within that line, pointing at the symbol.
